units.source_en: Perhaps events truly would unfold as Hidetada said, but as an instructor to the shogun’s household, he could not think that way.

えるわけにはいかなかった。

units.source_zh: 也许事情真如秀忠所言，但身为将军府修正，他不能这样想。

paragraphs.source_zh: 又右卫门不言。也许事情真如秀忠所言，但身为将军府修正，他不能这样想。

paragraphs.source_en: Hidetada sighed. “Ah! Please go to Sunpu at once, Master.”

units.source_en: Hidetada sighed. “Ah!
units.source_zh: 秀忠叹一声：“唉！

units.source_en: Please go to Sunpu at once, Master.”

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀忠叹一声：“唉！请先生即刻去骏府一趟吧。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes.”

units.source_en: “Yes.”

paragraphs.source_en: “I shall have Doi Ōi wait for now. Report to the retired shogun that Ōkubo Nagayasu pursued private gain and that his surviving family must therefore be arrested and punished at once.”

units.source_en: “I shall have Doi Ōi wait for now.
units.source_zh: “我先让土井大炊等一等。

units.source_en: Report to the retired shogun that Ōkubo Nagayasu pursued private gain and that his surviving family must therefore be arrested and punished at once.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我先让土井大炊等一等。你就禀告大御所，说大久保长安谋私，故要立刻逮捕其遗族加以惩罚。”

paragraphs.source_en: “And the joint declaration?”

units.source_en: “And the joint declaration?”
units.source_zh: “联名状一事呢？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “联名状一事呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Simply follow the retired shogun’s instructions. Say nothing of what I think.”

units.source_en: “Simply follow the retired shogun’s instructions. Say nothing of what I think.”
units.source_zh: “先生就听大御所示下，不要说我任何意思。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “先生就听大御所示下，不要说我任何意思。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes.”

units.source_en: “Yes.”

paragraphs.source_en: “The matter concerns Kazusa-no-suke. To let our father, whose days are numbered, learn of discord between his sons would be unfilial. What you said just now moved me deeply.”

units.source_en: “The matter concerns Kazusa-no-suke.
units.source_zh: “事情和上总介有关。

units.source_en: To let our father, whose days are numbered, learn of discord between his sons would be unfilial.
units.source_zh: 若是让时日无多的父亲知道兄弟不和，有违孝道。

units.source_en: What you said just now moved me deeply.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “事情和上总介有关。若是让时日无多的父亲知道兄弟不和，有违孝道。我方才听你讲时，颇为感触。”

paragraphs.source_en: Mataemon remained silent and bowed to the floor—Hidetada truly governed himself strictly according to duty and principle.

units.source_en: Mataemon remained silent and bowed to the floor—Hidetada truly governed himself strictly according to duty and principle.
units.source_zh: 又右卫门无言，伏地施礼——秀忠果然严格按照义理约束自己。

paragraphs.source_zh: 又右卫门无言，伏地施礼——秀忠果然严格按照义理约束自己。

paragraphs.source_en: “For certainty’s sake, allow me to repeat your command: because Ōkubo Nagayasu abused his office for private gain, Your Excellency intends to arrest and investigate his family. That private wrongdoing was…”

units.source_en: “For certainty’s sake, allow me to repeat your command: because Ōkubo Nagayasu abused his office for private gain, Your Excellency intends to arrest and investigate his family.

ja.t: べる、ということでございます。

units.source_zh: “为慎重起见，请容在下重复一遍：将军大人的意思，由于大久保长安利用职务谋私，故要抓他的家人查办。

units.source_en: That private wrongdoing was…”

paragraphs.source_zh: “为慎重起见，请容在下重复一遍：将军大人的意思，由于大久保长安利用职务谋私，故要抓他的家人查办。那谋私是……”

paragraphs.source_en: Munenori once more bowed his head solemnly. “As for Nagayasu’s surviving family, most are already adults. Knowing that the head of their house pursued private gain yet failing to stop him, they should be judged as accomplices.”

units.source_en: Munenori once more bowed his head solemnly. “As for Nagayasu’s surviving family, most are already adults.

units.source_en: Knowing that the head of their house pursued private gain yet failing to stop him, they should be judged as accomplices.”
units.source_zh: 知道家主谋私却不加以阻止，应按同谋论罪。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 宗矩再次郑重地垂下头，“说到长安的遗族，大都值成年。知道家主谋私却不加以阻止，应按同谋论罪。”

paragraphs.source_en: Hidetada did not answer. Having said his piece, Mataemon immediately rose. All around was utterly still, and a grim chill filled the room.

units.source_en: Hidetada did not answer.
units.source_zh: 秀忠不答。

units.source_en: Having said his piece, Mataemon immediately rose.
units.source_zh: 又右卫门说罢，便立刻站起身来。

units.source_en: All around was utterly still, and a grim chill filled the room.
units.source_zh: 周围十分寂静，室内一片肃杀。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀忠不答。又右卫门说罢，便立刻站起身来。周围十分寂静，室内一片肃杀。

paragraphs.source_en: By the time Mataemon had traversed the long corridor and reached the main gate, his whole body was drenched in sweat.

units.source_en: By the time Mataemon had traversed the long corridor and reached the main gate, his whole body was drenched in sweat.
units.source_zh: 走过长长的走廊，来到大门时，又右卫门已出了一身汗。

paragraphs.source_zh: 走过长长的走廊，来到大门时，又右卫门已出了一身汗。

paragraphs.source_en: The affair seemed like the gods’ and buddhas’ mockery and hatred of the human world. Lord Ieyasu, a hero without equal in his age, had encountered this horrifying affair in the twilight of his life. The retired shogun had endured hardship throughout his life and devoted all his strength to an age of peace. Yet, in a cruel tragedy, a deep pit had been dug beneath his very feet—his own son had joined hands with Osaka Castle and meant, once their father was dead, to destroy his elder brother!

units.source_en: The affair seemed like the gods’ and buddhas’ mockery and hatred of the human world.

ja.t: んでいるかのようだった。

units.source_zh: 此事仿佛是神佛对人世的嘲笑和憎恶。

units.source_en: Lord Ieyasu, a hero without equal in his age, had encountered this horrifying affair in the twilight of his life.

units.source_en: The retired shogun had endured hardship throughout his life and devoted all his strength to an age of peace. Yet, in a cruel tragedy, a deep pit had been dug beneath his very feet—his own son had joined hands with Osaka Castle and meant, once their father was dead, to destroy his elder brother!

units.source_zh: 大御所一生坎坷，为了太平盛世倾尽全力，然而令人悲苦的是，他的脚下竟有人挖下了深深的陷阱——自己的儿子和大坂城携手，等父亲死后，便要灭了兄长！

paragraphs.source_zh: 此事仿佛是神佛对人世的嘲笑和憎恶。家康公英杰一世，值此暮年之际，却发生了这等骇人之事。大御所一生坎坷，为了太平盛世倾尽全力，然而令人悲苦的是，他的脚下竟有人挖下了深深的陷阱——自己的儿子和大坂城携手，等父亲死后，便要灭了兄长！

paragraphs.source_en: But Munenori had no choice but to meet Ieyasu. He reached the hitching posts before the gate as a fine drizzle began to fall, but Mataemon no longer noticed it. He could think only, in anguish, of how Ieyasu would pass judgment.

units.source_en: But Munenori had no choice but to meet Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 但宗矩不得不去见家康。

units.source_en: He reached the hitching posts before the gate as a fine drizzle began to fall, but Mataemon no longer noticed it.
units.source_zh: 他来到大门前的拴马桩处，天空下起了细细的小雨，此时的又右卫门却无所感了。

units.source_en: He could think only, in anguish, of how Ieyasu would pass judgment.

ja.t: すのか――ただそれだけを、

units.source_zh: 他只是苦苦寻思，家康将会如何裁决？

paragraphs.source_zh: 但宗矩不得不去见家康。他来到大门前的拴马桩处，天空下起了细细的小雨，此时的又右卫门却无所感了。他只是苦苦寻思，家康将会如何裁决？

paragraphs.source_en: Yagyū Munenori returned to his residence and immediately began preparing for the journey to Sunpu, but his entire body continued to tremble. There was no such thing as everlasting peace of mind in human life; poisonous shoots were forever sprouting amid the ceaseless flow of days. Even so, he did not believe that Ōkubo Nagayasu had meant to bring trouble upon Ieyasu.

units.source_en: Even so, he did not believe that Ōkubo Nagayasu had meant to bring trouble upon Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 只是，他并不觉得大久保长安乃是为了给家康寻麻烦。

paragraphs.source_zh: 柳生宗矩回到宅邸，立刻着手安排去骏府，但他一直全身发抖。人生并无所谓永远的“安心”，在流动不息的时日中，经常萌发毒芽。只是，他并不觉得大久保长安乃是为了给家康寻麻烦。

paragraphs.source_en: That very night, Mataemon left Edo for Sunpu with two armed attendants leading the horses.
